Thanks for pasting the spreadsheet. That helps.

One thing stands out: about a third of the "Date back" cells are empty. That gap probably matters more than anything else here. A better tracker could look very different depending on what's behind those blanks. If people are forgetting to return seeds, the fix might be reminders. If people are returning seeds but nobody writes it down, it might be a quicker way to log returns. And a seed library often works differently from a book library: people may bring back seeds they saved from the plants they grew, a season later, maybe a different amount or variety. If that's how yours works, "out" and "back" might not line up one-to-one at all.

So before we talk about what to build: when you look at one of those rows with an empty "Date back," what's usually the real story behind it?
